plugins.name: Away message

plugins.description: When you're away, replies once to each person who messages you, with a note you write.

plugins.name: Dice
plugins.author: Mentos
plugins.description: Roll dice, flip coins and let chance pick for you, right in any chat.

plugins.name: Focus mode
plugins.author: Mentos
plugins.description: Rearrange Mentos for fewer distractions: hide tabs and stories, go compact, icons only.

plugins.name: Midnight
plugins.author: Mentos
plugins.description: A deep indigo theme with a violet accent, plus a text size you choose. Pick your own accent on its page.

plugins.name: Quick notes
plugins.author: Mentos
plugins.description: A private scratchpad page, kept on this device. Type /note in any chat to save a line.

plugins.author: Mentos
plugins.description: Send a quick nudge to a contact who also has Nudge. Peer to peer, no chat needed. Adds a tab to your bar.

plugins.author: Mentos
plugins.description: /shrug, /mock, /upper, /spoiler and friends. Also turns :shortcodes: into emoji as you send.

plugins.name: Weather
plugins.author: Mentos
plugins.description: Live weather at the top of your feed, from Open-Meteo. Pick your city on its page.
